recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast ensemble composition featuring four young protagonists in stylized, punk-inspired fantasy attire standing on a rocky outcrop, set against a dramatic sunset sky and a large, translucent spectral figure in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground quartet anchored by a central seated figure and three standing figures.
Large-scale spectral antagonist looming in the mid-ground behind the main cast.
Title treatment positioned at the top, integrated with symbolic icons like a bitten apple and a tentacle.
Warm sunset horizon contrasting with deep blue upper atmosphere.
coreInvariants: High-saturation color palette (purple, blue, red, gold).
Textured, layered costume design with studs and leather.
Dramatic, low-angle lighting on the subjects.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects in the lower two-thirds; one large translucent face in the upper center; title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated male figure and the vibrant purple-haired female figure next to him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant title, moves down to the central cast, then up to the large background face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with characters and atmospheric effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blues and purples in costumes and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold and orange from the sunset and title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red from the apple icon and costume details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary subjects against a desaturated, hazy background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between character silhouettes and the sky

letterConstructionRules: Chiseled 3D effect with gold metallic texture
Integration of illustrative elements into the letterforms (e.g., a snake-like vine wrapping the first letter)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter merged with a bitten apple icon
Numerical suffix styled with a blue cephalopod tentacle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, clean sans-serif for secondary credits placed above the main title.

avoid: Modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the adventurous and magical tone of the ensemble.
Provides the necessary weight and classical authority for a franchise title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic scene of four young adults in punk-fantasy leather costumes standing on a dark rock by the sea at sunset. A large, faint, ghostly face of a woman in a pirate hat should be visible in the clouds behind them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, gold, 3D chiseled serif title across the top. Incorporate a red apple icon on the left side of the text and a large stylized number '2' with a blue tentacle texture on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the title text metallic and 3D?
Are the four main characters clearly visible and distinct?
Is the background figure translucent and integrated into the sky?
Does the color palette balance warm sunset tones with cool costume colors?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the background spectral figure
Level of distress/texture on the costumes
Amount of 3D extrusion on the typography
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the ensemble pose.
Ensure the title does not obscure the faces of the main cast.
Verify the 3D lighting on the text matches the scene lighting.
Confirm the background figure feels like a 'spirit' rather than a solid person.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a foreground ensemble of stylized heroes with a large-scale translucent antagonist in the background, tied together by a high-contrast sunset-to-night sky gradient and metallic, icon-integrated display typography.
